title: Discipline
subtitle: Trading rules and daily habits — process over P&L.

kindHint.constraint: Kept unless you log a breach. Never adds to the score — it can only pull the day down.
kindHint.task: You tick it off. Every one you keep adds to the day's score.

hint.strict: A limit you never cross. One breach turns the day red — no warning tier.
hint.avoidance: A “No X” line. One slip is a warning; two scheduled days in a row turns the day red.
hint.building: Something you actively do. The share you keep sets the day's colour.

toggleHint.strict: Tap to flag a breach of this rule
toggleHint.avoidance: Tap to log a slip on this habit

tip.unloggedFix: You can still fill it in

process.away: Excused — not scored, and your streak carries over it.
process.unlogged: Nothing recorded. It scores zero in your 30-day figure and breaks your streak — fill it in and it counts properly.
process.noScope: No trades or check-in yet — log the day to score it.
process.green: Clean day — tasks done, nothing breached.
process.redSoft: Only {completed}/{total} tasks — tighten it up tomorrow.
process.hardBroken: Constraint breached ({count}) — that alone makes the day red.
process.noTrade: No trades today. Stick to your rules and that still counts.
process.noTradeWithTasks: No trades — it counts as a clean day. Your tasks didn't apply, so they sit out of their own rates and streaks.

streakBlocked.one: One unlogged day ({from}) broke your streak. Fill it in — past days have no deadline — or mark it as not counted.
streakBlocked.other: {days} unlogged days ({from} – {to}) broke your streak. Fill them in — past days have no deadline — or mark them as not counted.

streakBlockedDone.one: Day excused — your streak carries over it
streakBlockedDone.other: {days} days excused — your streak carries over them

stats.awayRangeHint: A holiday, illness, any stretch you're away — past or still ahead. These days won't count against you and your streak carries over them.
stats.awayRangeEmpty: Pick a start and end date.
stats.awayRangeTooLong: That's more than {max} days — mark it in shorter stretches.
stats.awayRangeDonePartial: {days} days won't be counted · {skipped} left as they are — you traded on them
stats.noRulesYetTitle: Track your discipline, not just your P&L
stats.noRulesExplain: Define how you want to trade with two kinds of rules:
stats.noRulesExplain2: Your non-negotiables — the limits that keep you safe.
stats.noRulesExplain3: The routines that sharpen your execution.
stats.noRulesExplain4: Track them daily and watch your discipline build over time — whatever your P&L does.
stats.addStarterHint: {count} common rules to get going, Mon–Fri. Edit or delete any of them later.
stats.perfSub: Average daily P&L & R-multiple, by discipline
stats.perfIndicativeHint: Enough days to show, not enough to bank on — daily P&L swings hard. Treat it as a direction until this bucket has {solid}+ days.
stats.perfUnconfirmed: {days} trading days aren't counted — you never reviewed them. Mark a day reviewed (or tick any rule on it) to include it.
stats.perfNoData: Log some trades on scored days to see this.
stats.trendSub: Scheduled days · up to the last 30
stats.perRuleSub: Compliance over active days · last 30 days

info.label: What is this?
info.currentStreak: How many clean days you're on right now.
info.bestStreak: Your longest clean streak in the year shown on the heatmap.
info.greenDays: Total clean days in the year shown on the heatmap.
info.discipline30: How well you kept your process over the last 30 days. A scheduled day you never filled in scores zero — recording is part of the process.
info.trend: Your score on each day something was scheduled. Days off aren't plotted; a scheduled day you never logged scores zero.
info.perRule: How often you keep each rule, over the days you recorded. Tasks and constraints are listed separately — they measure different things.
info.weekday: Which days of the week you stay most disciplined.
info.perf: Average daily P&L and R on disciplined vs. off-plan days. Only days you reviewed count — an un-reviewed day is silence, not evidence. Correlation, not proof.

awayRangeAllTraded.one: You traded that day, so there's nothing to excuse.
awayRangeAllTraded.other: You traded on all {days} of those days, so there's nothing to excuse.

stats.staleWarning: These numbers couldn't be refreshed, so they may be behind what you just logged.
stats.awayRangeButtonHint: Mark a whole stretch off at once.

day.noActiveRules: No active rules. Add some in the Manage tab.
day.noScheduledRules: No rules scheduled for this day.
day.checkInNoTradeHint: Didn't trade? Mark it so the day still counts — stick to your rules and it scores green.
day.confirmDayHint: Only reviewed days count in “Does discipline pay off?”.
day.awayHint: Holiday, illness, a day off. It won't count against you and your streak keeps running.
day.checkInNoTradeOnHint: This day counts as a disciplined no-trade day. Click to undo.
day.confirmDayOnHint: This day is marked as reviewed. Click to undo.
day.awayOnHint: This day is marked off. Click to count it again.
day.awayKeptTrading: You traded on this day, so Trading counts it anyway.

awayScopeHint.both: Neither Trading nor Daily counts this day.
awayScopeHint.trading: Trading skips this day. Your daily habits still count.
awayScopeHint.habits: Daily habits skip this day. Your trading still counts.

dayReview.readOnly: You can't edit a day that hasn't happened yet.
dayReview.dailyNotePlaceholder: Reflection for the whole day — shared across all trades on this day…

calendar.info:
One square per day, shaded by how much of your process you kept. Hatched = something was scheduled but nothing recorded; it breaks your streak (blue = excused). You can fill in any past day.

“Avg tasks” is your task completion on the days you recorded.
calendar.gridAria: Day-by-day grid for {year}. Use the arrow keys to move between days.

rules.title: Your trading rules
rules.subtitle: Define the trading rules you want to follow. Drag to reorder.
rules.namePlaceholder: e.g. No trading before the open
rules.typeLocked: Fixed once a rule exists — it decides how every logged day is read. To switch, delete this rule (past days keep their score) and add a new one.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.minOneDay: A rule needs at least one day
schedule.customHint: Tap the days to build your own schedule
schedule.forwardNarrowed: The days you removed stop counting from today. Past days keep the schedule they were scored under.
schedule.forwardWidened: The days you added start counting from today. Past days on those weekdays stay out of scope.
schedule.forwardBoth: The new schedule applies from today. Every past day keeps the schedule it was scored under.

rules.hardEmpty: No constraints yet — add a limit you never cross.
rules.softEmpty: No tasks yet — add a routine you want to keep.
rules.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? It stops applying from today, and past days keep their score.

habits.title: Daily habits
habits.subtitle: Everyday habits outside trading — sleep, gym, mindset.
habits.empty: No habits yet. Track everyday habits separately from your trading rules.

day.allDone: All habits done for this day. Nice.
day.someDoneRed: Only {done}/{total} habits kept — tighten the routine tomorrow.
day.none: No habits yet. Add habits to start tracking.
day.dayOff: No habit scheduled for this day.
day.pending: In progress — finish your habits before the day ends.
day.unlogged: Nothing recorded. It scores zero in your 30-day figure and breaks your streak — fill it in and it counts properly.
day.avoidCleanOnly: All clear — your avoidance habits count by staying untouched.
day.avoidPendingOnly: In progress — staying clean counts once the day is over.
day.avoidWarning: An avoidance habit slipped — that caps the day at warning. {done}/{total} building habits kept.
day.avoidWarningOnly: An avoidance habit slipped — that caps the day at warning. Twice in a row turns it red.
day.avoidBroken: Avoidance habit slipped two scheduled days running — the day is red, even with {done}/{total} building habits kept.
day.avoidBrokenOnly: Avoidance habit slipped two scheduled days running — the day is red.

habits.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? It stops applying from today, and past days keep their score.

perf.title: Do your habits pay off?
perf.sub: Average trading-day P&L on days you kept each habit vs. days you missed it.
perf.noData: Not enough trading days to compare yet.
perf.info: Your trading days split by whether you kept each habit — average net P&L and win rate. Only scheduled days count. Correlation, not proof.

year.info:
One square per day, shaded by how many building habits you kept. Avoidance habits never add to the score — they only pull a day down: one slip caps the day at warning, two scheduled days in a row turn it off plan.

“Avg tasks” is your completion on the days you recorded.

stats.trendSub: Scheduled days · up to the last 30
stats.consistencySub: How often you keep each habit, over the last 30 tracked days.
stats.weekdaySub: Which weekdays you keep your habits, last 12 weeks.

info.trend: The share of each day's building habits you completed. Avoidance habits can only pull a day down; a scheduled day you never filled in scores zero.
info.consistency: How often you keep each habit, over the days it was scheduled in the last 30. Building and avoidance are listed separately — they measure different things.
info.weekday: Average day score by weekday over the last 12 weeks, counting only days a habit was scheduled.

cards.streakInfo: Days in a row you kept your scheduled habits — 50%+ of building habits done, no avoidance habit broken. Today counts once it's over.
cards.bestInfo: Your longest habit streak in the year shown on the heatmap.
cards.greenInfo: Days you kept 50%+ of your building habits with no avoidance habit broken, in the year shown.
cards.completionInfo: Average day score over the last 30 days: the share of building habits done, zeroed if an avoidance habit broke or you never filled the day in. Days off and today sit out.

habits.typeLocked: Fixed once a habit exists — it decides how every logged day is read. To switch, delete this habit (past days keep their score) and add a new one.
